checks.why: a construction prints as `new`, not as an invocation: the kind comes from call_edges.kind, which the chain exporter used to drop, so `new Service()` and `svc.add(x)` were indistinguishable in every chain (#1107)
one constructor chaining to another is its own relation (`ctor`) — neither a call nor a construction
a method reference is NAMED at that line, not called: `method-ref` says so, where `call` would have claimed control passes through it there
every hop carries the line the CALL is written on — not only the callee's declaration, which its name already gives — and the tiers used are legended beneath the answer
--json carries every hop with its tier, kind and call site, and stdout alone is one document
